description: Source code for WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool class managing WebSocket socket connections, including request handling, socket allocation, and connection job management within the Chromium networking stack.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool
classes.description: Manages WebSocket client socket pooling, connection requests, and socket lifecycle within Chromium's networking stack.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::ConnectJobDelegate
classes.description: Handles callbacks and management of individual connect jobs for WebSocket sockets.

classes.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::StalledRequest
classes.description: Represents a queued request that is stalled due to socket limits or other constraints.

methods.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::RequestSocket
methods.description: Initiates a socket request, either starting a new connect job or queuing if limits are reached.

methods.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::CancelRequest
methods.description: Cancels a pending or active socket request.

methods.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::ReleaseSocket
methods.description: Releases a socket back to the pool after use.

methods.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::FlushWithError
methods.description: Fails all pending and queued requests with a specified error.

methods.name: WebSocketTransportClientSocketPool::OnConnectJobComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of a connect job, either handing out the socket or activating stalled requests.
